summary: Two-field getter (__thiscall): copies the object field at this+0x14 (this[5]) into *a2 when a2 is non-null, and the field at this+0x18 (this[6]) into *a3 when a3 is non-null; returns a3 as the result. No side effects; called from UI cursor-rectangle, collision-damage decay and text-render dispatcher paths.

operations.description: Guard on output pointer a2 being non-null; when null, skip writing the this+0x14 field.
Copy this[5] (field at this+0x14) into the caller output *a2.
Guard on output pointer a3 being non-null; when null, skip writing the this+0x18 field.
Copy this[6] (field at this+0x18) into the caller output *a3.
Return a3 as the function result.

unresolved: Identity of the owner object and the semantic meaning of the two returned fields are not established by the packet.
The existing analysis labels the fields as width/height based on caller context, but that naming has no direct packet evidence.
Whether both outputs must be provided together (a2 null while a3 used) is caller-dependent and unverified here.
